_why: Invariant 3 of CLAUDE.md says a number on this site is a claim with an owner, and until
2026-08-04 it carried `(not enforced)` beside it. Checking every figure took a venv, one
git clone and reading two type signatures, and FOUR OF SEVEN WERE WRONG: trailryx said
1,031 tests where the repository ran 1,064, tokenfuse said 513 where it runs 709, engram
said 424 where it collects 466, verdryx said 217 where it collects 292. None was wrong the
day it was written. That is the whole problem: a figure on a marketing page has no owner
and no clock, and the person it misleads is a stranger who cannot check it.
This file gives every one of them both. `scripts/service-numbers.sh` refuses a publish whose
pages disagree with what is written here, and refuses a page that states a figure nothing
It CANNOT check that a recorded value is still true: this repository has no access to the
others' test suites, and a network call in a publish gate trades silent staleness for a
flaky deploy. What it makes impossible is the silent case. What keeps the values true is
somebody running the commands below and writing the date back, and `measured_on` is what
says how long since anybody did.

This machine has no virtualenv for engram and its suite pulls fastembed, which downloads ONNX models, so the drift tool reports MEASURED NOTHING rather than agreement. The figure comes from engram's own README, which its CI gates against a real collection: 517 on a plain install and 524 with the encryption extra. It was 510 here against 511 upstream before 2026-08-28, so it was already a test behind; six manifest tests were added that day. Was 424 on the page and collects 466. One file, tests/test_encryption.py, is SKIPPED for want of sqlcipher3, which has no wheel for Python 3.14, so the true figure on a machine that has it is higher than this. Recorded as the number this command reproduces, with the condition named, rather than as an estimate of the number it would reach elsewhere. `@decided 2026-08-29`: taken as established from the earlier runs and NOT to be re-measured; the suite needs a venv and pulls model weights, and the doubt was never here.
